title: MessageStore::get_changes_since missing early-exit optimization present in Chat/ContactStore
description: ContactStore::get_changes_since and ChatStore::get_changes_since both short-circuit with an empty result when since_counter >= current_counter, avoiding a database query. MessageStore::get_changes_since (line 581 of message.rs) does not have this guard: it always executes the full SQL query even when the caller is already at the current state. In the common case where a client polls after already being up-to-date, this executes an unnecessary index scan over messages WHERE state_version > current_version (which returns 0 rows). The SELECT is fast because of the state_version index, but the round-trip and query overhead are avoidable. Fix: add the same if since_version >= current_version { return early } guard at the top of get_changes_since in message.rs, matching the pattern in contact.rs and chat.rs.
